ideal_model_scope: Six different numbers sampled uniformly without replacement from 49; independent of previous draw. This is a mathematical baseline, not verified actual mechanism, real-world success, gain or forecast.
display_definition: Each named identity must appear among the six normal numbers to complete its column; reserves never substitute.

structural_impossibility: If pair A/B covers different roads and triple A/C/D covers all three roads, B necessarily shares a road with C or D; exact identity matching remains necessary.
